name: The Dyson Sphere Twin Systems
map_primacy_note: Zone-attested by the map (§2.5: "Two abandoned Dyson spheres, twin systems") and anchored to loc_zone_dyson_sphere_frontier, but not yet a §8 placed-system entry — canonical_position_status=staging pending map §8 placement.
notes: The two abandoned Dyson spheres (twin systems) of the Dyson Sphere Frontier — the galaxy's foremost precursor megastructures, built by the Orak-Thuun (Celestial Engineers, polity_orak_thuun). Lethal approach conditions; derelict-choked orbital volumes; no sovereign state — contested by scavenger fleets and pirate confederations. The map names it the "Forbidden prize" and cites it as the reason no hegemon dominates the galaxy. Forced adjacency (map §5): Contested Frontier ↔ Dyson Sphere Frontier.
